fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. A skin disease is in the LORD's command to Moses (Numbers 5:2). A bodily discharge and being defiled by a dead body ride in the same verse, so that one verse holds three groups. Short verse, big list, and you picked the first one out of it like a pro.

Yes, baker. The guilty person "…must confess the sin he has committed." (Numbers 5:7) Confession comes first, and the making right follows in the same verse. Owning up is hard. I've watched a whole batch of cookies vanish off a cooling rack while I stood there covered in crumbs, and my first instinct was still to say "Wasn't me!"
